COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1173 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Alok Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. By means of this writ petition, the petitioner 
has sought quashing of the impugned order dated 
27.02.2023 passed by District Education Officer, 
Primary Education, Nainital and further the remark 
dated 14.05.2024, made by the Finance Officer 
(Elementary Education), School education, 
Nainital. 
4. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
5. Two weeks’ time thereafter is granted to the 
counsel for the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit. 
6. List on 18.10.2024.
7. In the meantime, no recovery shall be made 
from the petitioner. 
8. Stay Appl. No.01 of 2024 stands disposed of. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 04.07.2024
